formation_rationale: A bounded proving slice can be formed under explicit limitations. The request is specific enough to create a governed objective and first task set for the TDE Operator Readiness View while preserving the declared constraint that broader producer/adapter/runtime closure is only partially proven.
interpreted_intent: Implement and operate a bounded operator-facing TDE self-UI slice through the canonical implementation -> verification -> readiness path.
assumptions: The slice remains bounded to the TDE Operator Readiness View.
Any manual rescue or closure ambiguity will be explicitly logged as experiment evidence.
The experiment does not justify broad autonomy or full-product claims.
known_unknowns: Exact implementation shape of the first UI rendering path.
Whether post-build operated proof can be achieved without additional runtime glue.

proposed_objective.objective_title: Implement and operate the TDE Operator Readiness View proving slice
proposed_objective.objective_summary: Create and operate one bounded operator-facing UI slice that makes the TDE self-UI proving experiment inspectable through real execution state rather than descriptive documents alone.

proposed_success_criteria: A bounded objective is entered through the canonical experiment intake.
Canonical tasks are formed for the slice.
The view reflects real runtime/task state or post-build event updates.
The experiment leaves behind an inspectable evidence package.

proposed_first_task_set.task_title: Define and approve bounded slice scope, runtime assumptions, and evidence expectations
proposed_first_task_set.task_summary: Lock the slice scope, evidence standard, and declared experiment limitation into execution.

proposed_first_task_set.task_title: Define the canonical data/state bindings for the Operator Readiness View
proposed_first_task_set.task_summary: Specify what the UI reads and how state/evidence transitions are surfaced from canonical sources.

proposed_first_task_set.task_title: Implement the bounded Operator Readiness View thin slice
proposed_first_task_set.task_summary: Build the smallest working operator-facing UI slice for the experiment.

proposed_first_task_set.task_title: Verify the slice against real state change and capture operated proof
proposed_first_task_set.task_summary: Confirm the slice is operated and leaves behind inspectable proof, including any manual rescue used.
